authority: T0 common-tournament baseline declaration; not a microscopic action, TECT claim, completeness theorem, or physical-vacuum selection
role: null and low-energy effective baseline against which microscopic-origin candidates must add explanatory and predictive value

state_and_degrees_of_freedom.declared_scope: the experimentally tested low-energy relativistic quantum-field and classical-gravity descriptions relevant to the current partial boundary intake
state_and_degrees_of_freedom.fields: electromagnetic and other Standard-Model effective fields on a supplied Lorentzian background, plus a supplied effective metric for gravitational propagation
state_and_degrees_of_freedom.configuration_space: not frozen as one ultraviolet microscopic state space in this baseline version
state_and_degrees_of_freedom.gauge_redundancy: the established low-energy gauge redundancies are retained as effective structure rather than derived

law.form: a declared bundle of established domain-specific effective descriptions: renormalized Standard-Model effective field theory and Einstein-Hilbert gravity for propagation, plus the experimentally validated condensed-matter effective theories needed for superconducting flux and helium critical observables
law.parameter_domain: measured masses, charges, couplings, background state, renormalization convention, material constitutive data, universality assumptions, and each effective-theory validity window are inputs
law.boundary_conditions: experiment or observation specific; no single common finite-volume boundary convention is asserted
law.reference_state: no unique common global energy-zero or physical-vacuum state is fixed across the laboratory, condensed-matter, and astrophysical entries

observable_map.status: AVAILABLE PHENOMENOLOGICALLY IN EACH EXPERIMENTAL DOMAIN, NOT AS ONE MICROSCOPIC MAP
explains_in_scope: suppressed electromagnetic Lorentz anisotropy in the tested regime
near-common gravitational-wave and electromagnetic propagation under the declared source model
superconducting flux quantization through condensed-matter quantum theory
helium critical scaling through the appropriate effective universality description
does_not_explain: why these effective structures arise from one microscopic state space
the origin of the input couplings or hbar
a common vacuum transition or cooling history

inserted_or_matched_inputs: material-specific order parameters and constitutive data
round1_discovery_outputs: the currently registered low-energy observables are consistent with this effective baseline in their declared domains

preregistered_failure_conditions: an admitted candidate is not credited for reproducing an observable by reinserting the corresponding M0 effective structure or fitted constant

after the evidence-role and minimum-manifest freeze, a candidate must outperform this baseline on at least one admitted microscopic-origin discriminator or preregistered non-fitting validation relation
failure of the effective baseline in a declared tested domain must be recorded rather than absorbed into a microscopic candidate fit
candidate_verdict: RETAIN AS THE REQUIRED NULL/EFFECTIVE BASELINE; NOT ELIGIBLE AS A MICROSCOPIC PRE-A WINNER
no_overclaim: This declaration does not prove the Standard Model plus general relativity complete at all scales, define one common global vacuum, derive any microscopic origin, or select TECT. It only prevents a microscopic candidate from receiving credit for low-energy structures and fitted constants already supplied by the established effective baseline.
